BEFORE WE START

A few useful answers.

What should I share when I get in touch?

Tell us what needs doing, where the property is, and your preferred timing. Photos, rough measurements and any ideas for materials or finishes help us understand the job.

Can I discuss several jobs together?

Yes. Share your list of plumbing, painting, carpentry or maintenance jobs so we can discuss the scope and next steps together.

How do I check availability and service area?

Call or text +61 404 532 889 with your suburb and the work you need. We’ll discuss availability and whether we can help with your project.

How are the project details agreed?

We start with your requirements, then discuss the scope, materials and timing. Confirm the agreed work and price before the project begins.
